title: folder-sync zstd keyframes, worked examples, version 1
description: testdata/zstd/*.json: frames as the engine writes a .zst keyframe (PEP 0009 §6), each with the plain bytes it opens to. Every reader of a keyframe decodes every frame to exactly those bytes: the engine and `folder-sync serve` in Go (klauspost/compress), the accounts Worker in TypeScript (the vendored fzstd), the zstd command line. The plain bytes are the template with printf's %d filled by n and k = n*7919 mod 100003, for n below count.
